description: Given a list of integers arr and an integer k, return a new list of the same length in which every element greater than k is replaced by -1 and every element less than or equal to k is kept unchanged. The list may be empty and k can be any integer.
notes: VERINA's Lean postcondition does not state the length of the result (it reads result[i]! with a default value of 0 for out-of-range indices). Both specs add |result| == |arr|, which is what the upstream Dafny program (an in-place update of the array) and the task description mean, and what every VERINA test satisfies.
